about: The walkthrough's stations: where a 360-degree panorama is taken, in the project frame (metres, +x east, +y north, from Khufu's base centre), and the moment it is lit at. A moment is a date in the present calendar and a local solar time (render/giza/sun.py); an ancient state keeps the season and takes its own epoch's obliquity. by_state overrides a station's fields in one era, such as the eye standing on the Grand Gallery's walkway today; a raft floats a station on an era's open water. An inside station is lit by the era's lamps, not the sun, and names its own landmarks.

golden-south.label: late afternoon, November, the sun clear of Khafre in every era

sphinx-morning.label: early morning, November, low light across the Sphinx's face

june-dawn.label: just after sunrise, midsummer, the only season the sun reaches the north face

night-first-time.label: night, 10,450 BCE: Alnitak on the meridian at the low point of the belt's precessional swing

night-2450.label: night, 2450 BCE: Alnitak on the meridian

stations.name: South of Khufu
stations.where: Between the Great Pyramid and Khafre's causeway
stations.note: moved from (-30, -360) on 2026-09-24: there the built causeway's shadow reached the camera, and further north Khafre's does

stations.name: Above the Sphinx Temple
stations.where: On the line from Khafre's apex through the Sphinx's head
stations.note: z is absolute: the camera stays put while the sand of c. 1800 CE rises under it, and while the harbour of 2560 BCE and the claim eras' flood fill in below it.

stations.name: East of Khufu
stations.where: On the Great Pyramid's axis, beyond its mortuary temple and the queens

stations.name: The north face
stations.where: Below the entrance and al-Ma'mun's tunnel

stations.name: The panorama stand
stations.where: The rise south-west of Menkaure where the three stand in a row

stations.name: Khufu's mortuary temple
stations.where: On the basalt pavement of its court, the Great Pyramid's east face above
stations.note: z is absolute: 1.7 m over the pavement top (Petrie's thickness), the same floor in every era that has it.

stations.name: The Eastern Cemetery
stations.where: At the Eastern Cemetery's south-west corner, the queens' pyramids between it and Khufu
stations.note: Chosen from the mastaba footprints: 11 m from the nearest wall, ten mastabas within 45 m, and Khufu in clear view.

stations.name: On the harbour
stations.where: On a papyrus raft in the basin before the valley temples
stations.note: Only where an era has open water here: the harbour basin as built (render/giza/harbour.py BASIN) and the flood of the claim eras. The raft sets the eye 1.7 m above the water.

stations.name: Orion over Giza
stations.where: A kilometre north of the Great Pyramid, looking south along the meridian
stations.note: The stars are the sky bake's (pnpm run sky-bake): the bright catalogue precessed with Vondrak 2011 to the night's epoch and turned to the sidereal time Alnitak transits. The First Time is the claim's night; as built it is C2's 2450 BCE.

stations.name: The Grand Gallery
stations.where: At its foot, looking up the 47.8 m slope to the great step
stations.note: z is the channel floor under the eye (Petrie's slope, 23.36 m) plus 1.6 m; today the eye stands on the walkway

stations.name: The King's Chamber
stations.where: Inside the doorway, the coffer at the west end
